notes.title: SeeLight will be delayed
notes.content:
Dear Friends!

We're announcing today that SeeLight is going to take a more time  to bring to life.
We faced financial problems that have lead to delay for 1 or 2 years.

We understand that it might be disappointing to have to wait unknown amount of time for the release and are sorry for the this, but we are working hard to make an amazing game.

Anchor Games
